source_quotes.quote: The two-year Master's Degree Course in Global Security Studies falls under the Italian Master's Degree class in International Relations (LM-52).

The programme is accessible to students who possess a Bachelor's Degree in Humanities and Social Sciences, namely in the following disciplinary areas: International Relations, History and Philosophy, Economics, Law, Political Science, Sociology, Foreign Languages.

An international English language certificate issued by an Institution recognised by the Italian Ministry of University and Research (MUR), B2 level of the Common European Framework of Reference is required.
Department: Political and Legal Studies / Duration: 2 years
6th Call - No Visa Applicants ... From July 1, 2026 (00:01 am CEST) To November 20, 2026 (11:59 pm CET)
1st Call – Early Bird ... From November 24, 2025 (00:01 am CET) To December 22, 2025 (11:59 pm CET)
